_comment: Measured, not aspirational. Regenerate with `make eval-real` and commit the new file in the same PR as the change that moved it. Never hand-edit a score.
_tolerance_rationale: One answerable case is worth 1/21 = 0.0476. A tolerance below that fires on a single case flipping, which is noise, not regression; 0.05 absorbs exactly one case and blocks two (0.0952). Sampling variance is not the driver here - temperature is 0.0 - so the tolerance is sized by set granularity.
